issues.reason: Revenue excludes financial services while group EBITDA includes bank ZENIT since Q4 2016. No unqualified EBITDA margin or generic industrial net debt computed from bank-inclusive cash.

Profit of group and profit attributable to shareholders kept separate. No substitution of total comprehensive income. Annual KPI charts are rounded; exact IFRS tables retained separately and preferred.
2026 revenue and nonbank EBIT relate to continuing operations; 2025 H1 comparative is restated after tyre/disposal perimeter change. All-operation historical revenue is not relabelled as continuing.
FY2021 and selected historical financial/physical metrics remain missing; old US GAAP presentations are downloaded but not mapped as IFRS.

Company investments include geological/technical measures and are not called cash CAPEX. Cash PPE and intangible acquisitions come from cash-flow statement. Group CFO includes financial-services flows.
Homepage H1 2025 file 688c69420ff9d627454521.pdf is RAS, not IFRS; excluded from consolidated data. SKRIN IFRS documents have independently recorded disclosure dates.
Source dates for old annual reports not confirmed. No LTM/daily valuation; source downloads do not mean all tables extracted.
